lookupPatient.description: Use only when a phone number is ambiguous or incomplete and you need deterministic normalization or repair. If result.message exists, say it verbatim.

messages.content: Przepraszam, nie udało mi się teraz potwierdzić numeru telefonu.

checkAvailability.description: Return appointment availability for a known visit type and time preference in Europe/Warsaw. Use specific_time for exact hours, broad windows for morning/afternoon/evening, or first_available for nearest slots. Prefer spokenLabel or spokenTime. If result.message exists, say it verbatim.

messages.content: Przepraszam, mam chwilowy problem ze sprawdzeniem terminów.

searchKnowledgeBase.description: Answer non-medical clinic questions from the local knowledge base, including organizational details, services, and confirmed pricing. If the result is missing or uncertain, say so and do not invent details.

messages.content: Przepraszam, mam chwilowy problem z wyszukaniem tej informacji.

createEvent.description: Create a booking only after the caller selected one slot and confirmed the summary. Pass slotStart and slotEnd exactly with service, timezone, language, patient full name, and either a normalized phone or a clear raw phone number. Never confirm booking before success. Booking SMS must stay non-blocking. If result.message exists, say it verbatim.

messages.content: Przepraszam, nie udało mi się teraz zapisać wizyty.

createReceptionTask.description: Create a receptionist follow-up only after the caller name and phone are confirmed. Pass taskType, patient full name, and either a normalized phone or a clear raw phone number, plus only structured optional fields such as serviceBucket or preferredCallbackWindow. Do not add free-text notes.

messages.content: Jeszcze chwila, kończę zapisywać prośbę dla recepcji.
Przepraszam, nie udało mi się teraz zapisać prośby dla recepcji.

sendSmsToReceptionists.description: Send the internal receptionist SMS only after createReceptionTask returned success and you have its taskId. This is internal-only. If it fails, the saved reception task still exists.

sendSmsToPatient.description: Send a manual booking-confirmation SMS only after createEvent succeeded. Pass the calendarEventId, patient identity, appointment timing, booked service, and prefer the live caller number when available.
